big_story.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields Sets IPO Band
big_story.subhead: COAL INDIA TO OFFLOAD 10 PERCENT STAKE IN MAHANADI COALFIELDS IPO OPENING NOVEMBER 19
paragraphs: State-owned giant Coal India is preparing to offload a 10 percent stake in its subsidiary, Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd, through an initial public offering opening on November 19. The company has fixed the price band at ₹129 to ₹136 per share, aiming to raise up to ₹8,981 crore from the offer.

The public issue represents a significant state asset divestment in India's energy sector, targeting an overall corporate valuation of up to $9.55 billion. Bidding for the mega issue will run across retail, high-net-worth, and institutional investor tranches.

Market participants are analyzing the valuation as the Nifty 50 traded down 0.31% in today's session so far with energy stocks lagging. The response to the ₹8,981 crore offering will serve as a crucial bellwether for appetite in primary market issuances.
big_story.pullbox: Coal India's 10% stake sale in Mahanadi Coalfields at ₹129-136 per share tests primary market demand for energy assets.

explains.title: What is an IPO Price Band?
paragraphs: An IPO price band is the floor and cap price range set by a company and its investment bankers for selling shares to the public. Investors submit bids specifying the number of shares and price they are willing to pay within this range.
After the bidding window closes, the final share price is calculated based on cumulative demand. Bids placed at or above the final cut-off price are allocated shares proportionally.

Indian semiconductor startup Bharat Semi has raised ₹215 crore ($24 million) in a seed funding round. The company develops specialized AI image sensors tailored for high-performance visual processing.

Bharat Semi plans to deploy the capital to target surveillance and consumer devices markets first. The startup eventually aims to scale its AI sensor technology for integration into advanced robotics platforms.

story_1.headline: Fairfax to Exit IIFL Finance via ₹3,454 Crore Block Deal
paragraphs: Fairfax is set to completely exit IIFL Finance by selling its entire 13% stake through a block deal valued at ₹3,454 crore. The transaction is priced at ₹611 per share, marking a significant divestment by the investment firm.

The decision enables Fairfax to monetize its long-standing holding in the non-banking financial company. Market participants are watching the deal closely as it reshapes IIFL Finance's institutional shareholding structure.

story_2.headline: Persistent Systems Secures ₹7,600 Cr for Nagarro Deal
paragraphs: Khaitan & Co has advised Persistent Systems on securing ₹7,600 crore in acquisition financing for its deal involving Nagarro SE. The capital arrangement equips the firm with substantial funding to execute its strategic expansion.
The deal highlights rising cross-border M&A activity among Indian technology service providers looking to expand globally.

story_3.headline: Canada and India Near Finalizing Free Trade Agreement
paragraphs: Canada and India are on the cusp of finalizing a comprehensive free trade deal, according to Canada's high envoy. The upcoming agreement aims to strengthen bilateral economic cooperation and expand market access.

geopolitics.headline: PM Modi Urges Stability, Unveils Seafarer Initiative
paragraphs: At the East Asia Summit, Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared that the world today urgently needs peace, stability, and predictability to sustain economic growth. Highlighting crucial vulnerabilities in maritime trade networks, PM Modi announced a new international initiative designed to protect and secure seafarers across global shipping routes. Simultaneously, India and ASEAN members stressed the importance of regional peace while pledging deeper cooperation in energy transition and the green economy.

The move arrives as geopolitical conflicts and supply chain disruptions threaten maritime commerce and escalate transit costs for international traders. Establishing reliable maritime security protocols is vital for safeguarding India's sea-based trade, energy imports, and export competitiveness across Asian trade corridors. However, translating high-level diplomatic pledges into enforceable operational security and coordinated green energy infrastructure across diverse ASEAN economies remains a key challenge for regional trade partners.

big_story.headline: Nifty Hits Nine-Month High Driven by Banking Sector Surge
big_story.text: The Nifty 50 index surged to a nine-month high, powered primarily by strong buying momentum in major banking stocks. Investor confidence in India's financial sector continues to rally the broader equity markets. This upward movement reflects sustained domestic liquidity and robust banking sector balance sheets driving economic optimistic sentiment across Indian exchanges.

big_story.headline: Self-Reliance in Defence Boosts India's National Security Framework
big_story.text: An official release highlighted how India's push for self-reliance in defence manufacturing is actively powering its national security architecture. Indigenous production efforts aim to reduce dependence on foreign imports while strengthening domestic industrial capacity. This strategic focus ensures enhanced military readiness and boosts local engineering and manufacturing ecosystems across the country.

venture_vault.headline: Indian AI Startups Secure $1.91 Billion in Funding Across 102 Rounds
venture_vault.text: Artificial intelligence startups in India have raised an impressive $1.91 billion across 102 funding rounds so far in 2026. The massive capital inflow underlines booming investor confidence in domestic machine learning and automation technologies. This surge in venture capital funding positions India as an emerging hub for scalable AI solutions on the global stage.

venture_vault.headline: Karta AI Secures ₹28.52 Crore Seed Round Led by Peer Capital
venture_vault.text: Tech startup Karta AI raised ₹28.52 crore in a fresh seed funding round co-led by Peer Capital and Cedar Hill Capital. The funding will support the development of its artificial intelligence platform and expand operations. For India's competitive startup landscape, the investment highlights sustained venture interest in early-stage enterprise AI innovations.

geopolitics.headline: Quad Leaders Convene Summit to Deepen Indo-Pacific Strategic Ties
geopolitics.text: Leaders from Japan, Australia, India, and the United States met for the Quad Leaders’ Summit to deliberate on regional security and economic cooperation. The multilateral engagement underscores India's strategic role in ensuring a free, open, and resilient Indo-Pacific. Stronger diplomatic coordination among member nations provides a counterweight to regional security challenges.
geopolitics.source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

geopolitics.headline: Global Potato Summit Drives International Agri-Trade Focus to India
geopolitics.text: The Global Potato Summit has brought international trade discussions and agricultural investment opportunities directly to India's economic agenda. The event facilitates high-level dialogue on global supply chains, farming innovations, and cross-border trade. For Indian agriculture, enhanced international engagement opens pathways for foreign investments and export opportunities in agri-commodities.
